easy: Able to feel better and get strong again quickly after something bad happens.

ex.en: My resilient puppy was playing again the day after his shots.
ex.ko: 내 강아지는 주사를 맞은 다음 날 금방 회복해서 다시 놀았다.

easy: Able to spring back into shape after being pressed or stretched.

ex.en: The resilient ball bounced high off the floor.
ex.ko: 탄력 있는 공이 바닥에서 높이 튀어 올랐다.

easy: A device that sends internet signals to the computers and phones in your home.

ex.en: Dad restarted the router when the Wi-Fi stopped working.
ex.ko: 와이파이가 끊기자 아빠는 라우터를 다시 켰다.

easy: A day of rest and prayer each week in some religions.

ex.en: On the Sabbath, my grandmother goes to church and rests.
ex.ko: 안식일에 할머니는 교회에 가서 쉬신다.

easy: Cut so that it takes less time or has fewer parts.

ex.en: The snow gave us a shortened school day.
ex.ko: 눈 때문에 오늘은 수업 시간이 단축되었다.

easy: A tool with a wide scoop and a long handle, used for digging.

ex.en: We used a shovel to dig a hole for the new tree.
ex.ko: 우리는 삽으로 새 나무를 심을 구덩이를 팠다.

easy: The last part of a person's name, shared with the rest of the family.

ex.en: My surname is Park, just like my dad's.
ex.ko: 내 성은 아빠처럼 박이다.

easy: Having the same meaning, or almost the same meaning.

ex.en: 'Big' and 'large' are synonymous words.
ex.ko: 'big'과 'large'는 뜻이 같은 말이다.

easy: Held in place with sticky tape.

ex.en: The taped poster stayed on the wall all week.
ex.ko: 테이프로 붙인 포스터는 일주일 내내 벽에 붙어 있었다.

easy: Saved on a tape so you can listen or watch later.

ex.en: We listened to a taped message from our teacher.
ex.ko: 우리는 선생님이 녹음해 둔 메시지를 들었다.

easy: Using something well for a purpose.

ex.en: Good utilization of your time helps you finish homework.
ex.ko: 시간을 잘 활용하면 숙제를 끝낼 수 있다.

easy: To quickly close and open one eye to share a secret or joke.

ex.en: My sister winked at me so I would keep the secret.
ex.ko: 누나가 비밀을 지키라고 나에게 윙크했다.

easy: To shine on and off, like a tiny light.

ex.en: The stars winked in the night sky.
ex.ko: 밤하늘에서 별들이 깜빡였다.

easy: About stars, planets, and outer space.

ex.en: We looked at the moon through an astronomical telescope.
ex.ko: 우리는 천체 망원경으로 달을 보았다.

easy: So big that it is hard to imagine.

ex.en: The number of stars in space is astronomical.
ex.ko: 우주에 있는 별의 수는 천문학적이다.

easy: Clothes that you wear, especially for a special event.

ex.en: My attire for the school play was a pirate costume.
ex.ko: 학교 연극에서 내 복장은 해적 의상이었다.

easy: A famous person's name written by their own hand.

ex.en: I got the soccer player's autograph after the game.
ex.ko: 나는 경기가 끝난 뒤 그 축구 선수의 사인을 받았다.

easy: A rod in the middle of a wheel that lets it turn.

ex.en: The wagon's axle broke, so the wheel fell off.
ex.ko: 수레의 차축이 부러져서 바퀴가 빠졌다.

easy: A plant with grain that people eat and feed to animals.

ex.en: Mom put barley in the soup.
ex.ko: 엄마는 수프에 보리를 넣으셨다.

easy: About plants.

ex.en: We saw rare flowers at the botanical garden.
ex.ko: 우리는 식물원에서 희귀한 꽃들을 보았다.

easy: Metal wires on your teeth that help them grow straight.

ex.en: I got braces so my teeth will grow straight.
ex.ko: 나는 이가 가지런해지도록 교정기를 끼웠다.

easy: Likely to get people's interest because it stands out.

ex.en: A catchy title made me want to read the book.
ex.ko: 눈길을 끄는 제목 때문에 나는 그 책을 읽고 싶어졌다.

easy: Done in a formal way for a special event.

ex.en: The principal wore a ceremonial robe at graduation.
ex.ko: 교장 선생님은 졸업식에서 의식용 가운을 입으셨다.

easy: A paper that tells a bank to pay money to someone.

ex.en: Grandma sent me a cheque for my birthday.
ex.ko: 할머니가 내 생일에 수표를 보내 주셨다.

easy: The planned steps and moves of a dance show.

ex.en: The choreography for our school dance show took weeks to practice.
ex.ko: 우리 학교 댄스 공연의 안무는 연습하는 데 몇 주가 걸렸다.

easy: To happen at the same time.

ex.en: My birthday coincides with our school field day this year.
ex.ko: 올해 내 생일은 학교 운동회 날과 겹친다.

easy: To hold an event to honor an important day.

ex.en: We commemorate Independence Day with fireworks.
ex.ko: 우리는 독립기념일을 불꽃놀이로 기념한다.

easy: To remember and honor someone or something in a special way.

ex.en: Our school planted a tree to commemorate the old principal.
ex.ko: 우리 학교는 옛 교장 선생님을 기리려고 나무를 심었다.

easy: A big reptile with a long snout and sharp teeth that lives in warm rivers.

ex.en: The crocodile lay still in the muddy river.
ex.ko: 악어가 진흙탕 강에 가만히 누워 있었다.

easy: A soft cloth or pad that a baby wears to catch pee and poop.

ex.en: Mom changed the baby's diaper.
ex.ko: 엄마는 아기의 기저귀를 갈아 주셨다.

easy: To eat the main meal of the evening.

ex.en: We dine together as a family every night.
ex.ko: 우리 가족은 매일 밤 함께 저녁을 먹는다.

easy: A very large deer from North America with big, branching antlers.

ex.en: An elk with huge antlers walked across the meadow.
ex.ko: 커다란 뿔을 가진 엘크가 풀밭을 가로질러 걸어갔다.

easy: Being so tired that you have no energy left.

ex.en: After the long hike, we fell asleep from exhaustion.
ex.ko: 긴 하이킹이 끝나고 우리는 지쳐서 잠이 들었다.

easy: In a way that many people know about.

ex.en: The Leaning Tower of Pisa is famously tilted.
ex.ko: 피사의 사탑은 기울어진 것으로 유명하다.

easy: In a very good way.

ex.en: We got along famously at the party.
ex.ko: 우리는 파티에서 아주 잘 어울렸다.

easy: Catching and throwing the ball when your team is not batting.

ex.en: Her fielding was great; she caught every ball.
ex.ko: 그녀의 수비는 훌륭해서 모든 공을 잡았다.

easy: The mark left by the tiny lines on the tip of your finger.

ex.en: Your fingerprint is different from everyone else's.
ex.ko: 네 지문은 다른 모든 사람의 지문과 다르다.

easy: A man who catches fish for his job.

ex.en: The fisherman pulled a big fish into his boat.
ex.ko: 어부는 큰 물고기를 배 안으로 끌어올렸다.

easy: To move up and down quickly in the wind, making noise.

ex.en: The flag flapped in the strong wind.
ex.ko: 깃발이 강한 바람에 펄럭였다.

easy: Old stories, sayings, and songs that people pass down for many years.

ex.en: Grandma told me folklore about a tiger and a rabbit.
ex.ko: 할머니는 호랑이와 토끼에 관한 민간전승 이야기를 들려주셨다.

easy: Willing to stop being angry at someone who made a mistake.

ex.en: Mom is very forgiving when I break something by accident.
ex.ko: 내가 실수로 뭔가를 깨뜨려도 엄마는 아주 너그럽다.

easy: About a galaxy, such as the Milky Way.

ex.en: Our sun is far from the galactic center.
ex.ko: 우리 태양은 은하 중심에서 멀리 떨어져 있다.

easy: A person who takes care of plants in a garden.

ex.en: The gardener watered the roses every morning.
ex.ko: 정원사는 매일 아침 장미에 물을 주었다.

easy: A person who is paid to work in a garden.

ex.en: Our school hired a gardener to plant new flowers.
ex.ko: 우리 학교는 새 꽃을 심을 정원사를 고용했다.

easy: A very happy feeling that makes you laugh.

ex.en: The kids shouted with glee when the snow began to fall.
ex.ko: 눈이 내리기 시작하자 아이들은 기뻐서 소리를 질렀다.

easy: Having to do with the force that pulls things toward the ground.

ex.en: The Moon's gravitational pull moves the ocean tides.
ex.ko: 달의 중력이 바닷물의 조수를 움직인다.

easy: Eating grass and plants in a field, as cows and sheep do.

ex.en: The cows spent the day grazing in the green meadow.
ex.ko: 소들은 푸른 풀밭에서 하루 종일 풀을 뜯었다.

easy: Passed from parents to their children, like a title or land.

ex.en: In some countries, a king's job is hereditary.
ex.ko: 어떤 나라에서는 왕의 자리가 세습된다.

easy: A short break or pause in something.

ex.en: The band took a hiatus for a year.
ex.ko: 그 밴드는 1년 동안 활동을 쉬었다.

easy: In a terrible, awful way.

ex.en: The soup tasted horribly salty.
ex.ko: 그 수프는 끔찍하게 짰다.

easy: Sweet, sugary topping spread on cakes.

ex.en: I put pink icing on the birthday cake.
ex.ko: 나는 생일 케이크에 분홍색 아이싱을 발랐다.

easy: The ability to think and learn.

ex.en: Reading books helps build your intellect.
ex.ko: 책을 읽으면 지성을 키우는 데 도움이 된다.

easy: A place where highways cross on different levels so cars can switch roads.

ex.en: Our car got stuck in traffic at the big interchange.
ex.ko: 우리 차는 큰 인터체인지에서 교통 체증에 걸렸다.

easy: A round handle that you turn or pull, like on a door.

ex.en: I turned the knob and opened the door.
ex.ko: 나는 손잡이를 돌려서 문을 열었다.

easy: Washing clothes and bed sheets.

ex.en: Laundering my soccer clothes is my job on Sundays.
ex.ko: 일요일에 내 축구복을 세탁하는 것은 내 일이다.

easy: A book where a store writes down the money it gets and spends.

ex.en: The shopkeeper wrote every sale in his ledger.
ex.ko: 가게 주인은 모든 판매를 장부에 적었다.

easy: Bread baked in one big piece that you cut into slices.

ex.en: Mom bought a warm loaf of bread from the bakery.
ex.ko: 엄마는 빵집에서 따뜻한 빵 한 덩이를 사 오셨다.

easy: Bad computer programs made to harm computers.

ex.en: The antivirus program stopped the malware before it hurt our computer.
ex.ko: 백신 프로그램이 악성 코드가 우리 컴퓨터를 해치기 전에 막아 주었다.

easy: A person who copies how others talk and act, often to be funny.

ex.en: My cousin is a great mimic who sounds just like our teacher.
ex.ko: 내 사촌은 선생님과 똑같은 목소리로 흉내를 잘 내는 사람이다.

easy: A big painting made right on a wall.

ex.en: Students painted a colorful mural on the school wall.
ex.ko: 학생들은 학교 벽에 알록달록한 벽화를 그렸다.

easy: A very large number of things.

ex.en: A myriad of stars filled the night sky.
ex.ko: 무수히 많은 별이 밤하늘을 가득 채웠다.

easy: Having to do with the nose.

ex.en: A cold can block your nasal passages.
ex.ko: 감기에 걸리면 콧속 통로가 막힐 수 있다.

easy: Sounding like you are talking through a stuffy nose.

ex.en: Her voice sounded nasal because she had a cold.
ex.ko: 그녀는 감기에 걸려서 목소리에서 콧소리가 났다.

easy: In a clean and tidy way.

ex.en: She folded her clothes neatly and put them in the drawer.
ex.ko: 그녀는 옷을 깔끔하게 개어서 서랍에 넣었다.

easy: Flipped upside down.

ex.en: An overturned boat floated on the lake.
ex.ko: 뒤집힌 보트가 호수 위에 떠 있었다.

easy: To move a boat through water using a paddle.

ex.en: We paddled the canoe across the calm lake.
ex.ko: 우리는 고요한 호수 위에서 카누의 노를 저었다.

easy: To play and splash in shallow water.

ex.en: The little kids paddled in the shallow water.
ex.ko: 어린아이들이 얕은 물에서 물장난을 쳤다.

easy: A colorful bird with a curved beak that can copy sounds.

ex.en: Our parrot says hello every morning.
ex.ko: 우리 앵무새는 매일 아침 인사를 한다.

easy: A short wooden pin that is pushed or hammered into something.

ex.en: We hammered a peg into the ground to hold the tent.
ex.ko: 우리는 텐트를 고정하려고 땅에 말뚝을 박았다.

easy: Without strength or the ability to do anything.

ex.en: I felt powerless when I couldn't help my sick puppy.
ex.ko: 아픈 강아지를 도와줄 수 없어서 나는 무력감을 느꼈다.

easy: Dealing with things in a sensible, practical way.

ex.en: Dad took a pragmatic approach and used tape to fix the toy.
ex.ko: 아빠는 실용적으로 접근해서 테이프로 장난감을 고치셨다.

easy: A factory that cleans a raw material, like oil, to make it ready to use.

ex.en: Oil is cleaned at a refinery to make gasoline.
ex.ko: 석유는 정제소에서 깨끗이 정제되어 휘발유가 된다.

easy: A deep, sad feeling about doing something wrong.

ex.en: He felt remorse after he broke his friend's toy.
ex.ko: 그는 친구의 장난감을 망가뜨린 뒤 뉘우쳤다.

easy: A person who comes from Norway, Sweden, or Denmark.

ex.en: My neighbor is Scandinavian; her family is from Sweden.
ex.ko: 내 이웃은 스칸디나비아 사람이고 그녀의 가족은 스웨덴 출신이다.

easy: To walk slowly without lifting your feet.

ex.en: Grandpa shuffled slowly down the hall in his slippers.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 슬리퍼를 신고 복도를 천천히 발을 끌며 걸으셨다.

easy: Made to look or work like the real thing.

ex.en: Pilots practice in a simulated airplane.
ex.ko: 조종사들은 모의 비행기에서 연습한다.

easy: The shape of buildings or hills against the sky.

ex.en: We saw the city skyline from the bridge.
ex.ko: 우리는 다리에서 도시의 스카이라인을 보았다.

easy: A thick, flat piece of something.

ex.en: Dad cut a thick slab of cheese for me.
ex.ko: 아빠는 나에게 치즈를 두껍게 한 덩이 잘라 주셨다.

easy: A soft, thin covering that goes over your foot and leg.

ex.en: I wore warm stockings under my dress in winter.
ex.ko: 나는 겨울에 드레스 안에 따뜻한 스타킹을 신었다.

easy: Added to give more of what is missing.

ex.en: The teacher gave us supplemental reading to practice.
ex.ko: 선생님은 연습용으로 보충 읽기 자료를 주셨다.

easy: An athlete who races in swimming contests.

ex.en: My sister is a fast swimmer on the school team.
ex.ko: 우리 누나는 학교 팀에서 빠르게 수영하는 선수이다.

easy: A person who moves through water using their arms and legs.

ex.en: I am a slow swimmer, but I love the pool.
ex.ko: 나는 수영은 느리지만 수영장을 좋아한다.

easy: Fast electronic dance music with a strong beat.

ex.en: The dance class played techno music.
ex.ko: 댄스 수업에서 테크노 음악이 흘러나왔다.

easy: With no conditions or limits.

ex.en: My dog gives me unconditional love.
ex.ko: 우리 강아지는 나에게 무조건적인 사랑을 준다.

easy: So special that you will always remember it.

ex.en: Our trip to the zoo was unforgettable.
ex.ko: 우리의 동물원 여행은 잊을 수 없는 경험이었다.

easy: To make something less strong.

ex.en: Skipping meals can weaken your body.
ex.ko: 끼니를 거르면 몸이 약해질 수 있다.

easy: To get less strong.

ex.en: The storm weakened and the wind slowed down.
ex.ko: 폭풍이 약해지면서 바람이 잦아들었다.

easy: A small camera on a computer that shows you to other people online.

ex.en: I waved at Grandma through the webcam.
ex.ko: 나는 웹캠으로 할머니께 손을 흔들었다.

easy: To end something completely, like a rule.

ex.en: The school decided to abolish the old rule about hats.
ex.ko: 학교는 모자에 관한 옛 규칙을 폐지하기로 했다.

easy: So good that people respect and like it.

ex.en: It was admirable that he shared his lunch.
ex.ko: 그가 점심을 나눠 준 것은 훌륭한 일이었다.

easy: Liking to try new and exciting things.

ex.en: My adventurous cousin climbed the tallest tree.
ex.ko: 모험을 좋아하는 내 사촌은 가장 높은 나무에 올랐다.

easy: Suddenly scared that something bad may happen.

ex.en: The dog was alarmed by the loud thunder.
ex.ko: 개는 큰 천둥소리에 놀랐다.

easy: A book that gathers many stories or poems together.

ex.en: Our class read an anthology of animal poems.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 동물 시 선집을 읽었다.

easy: A large animal like a gorilla or chimp that has a very short tail or none.

ex.en: The ape swung from branch to branch.
ex.ko: 유인원이 가지에서 가지로 건너뛰었다.

easy: To bother someone again and again.

ex.en: My little brother badgers me to play every day.
ex.ko: 내 동생은 매일 나에게 놀자고 귀찮게 군다.

easy: To ask again and again until someone says yes.

ex.en: I badgered Dad until he said yes to a puppy.
ex.ko: 나는 아빠가 강아지를 허락하실 때까지 졸랐다.

easy: Friendly, playful talk with light teasing.

ex.en: The teammates shared friendly banter on the bus.
ex.ko: 팀 친구들은 버스에서 가벼운 농담을 주고받았다.

easy: A person who offers an amount of money to buy something.

ex.en: The highest bidder won the old toy at the auction.
ex.ko: 가장 높은 값을 부른 사람이 경매에서 낡은 장난감을 샀다.

easy: Shining very brightly and hotly.

ex.en: We hid from the blazing sun under a tree.
ex.ko: 우리는 이글거리는 태양을 피해 나무 아래에 숨었다.

easy: A movie or book that a huge number of people love.

ex.en: That superhero movie was a summer blockbuster.
ex.ko: 그 슈퍼히어로 영화는 여름 블록버스터였다.
